/me The basic roll format: !roll [dice# between 1-100]d[face# between 1-1 000 000 000]

Make sure to include your twitch account name in the "excluded display name" field below. This Ensures you only use the premium version of the roll command when you type it as broadcaster into the chat :3!
Configure these throw Item nodes as desired. The throw item node below this message triggers when neither of the preceeding parameter filters equal the ThrowDiceFaces amount they check for.

The DiceAmount and DicesFaces filters below this message node set limits on user input. By default, the number of dice thrown is limited to 100 and the number of faces to 1 billion.Feel free to adjust as necessary. Don't forget to update the black Twitch Chat Node if you do :3!

The basic dice roll command randomizes output between 1 and the range defined by:[BasicDiceAmount]
	x
[BasicDiceFaces]This simplification can result in impossible results and functions as an approximation. The premium command randomizes and adds together dice of the specified type until the input amount is reached and returns a far more accurate result (while also including logic to allow for thrown objects). Enjoy :3!
